## SQL 구조 마스터 - where, group by, order by --- ### SQL 기본 패턴 2 ```sql SELECT FROM WHERE GROUP BY ORDER BY ``` ### [ 실습 ]
1. 구조 맞춰보기 > ✏️ > > 1. ORDER BY SUM(delivery_time) desc > > 1. GROUP BY cuisine_type > > 1. WHERE day_of_the_week=’Weekend’ > > 1. FROM food_orders > > 1. SELECT cuisine_type, SUM(delivery_time) total_delivery_time 정답 ```sql SELECT cuisine_type, SUM(delivery_time) total_delivery_time FROM food_orders WHERE day_of_the_week=’Weekend’ GROUP BY cuisine_type ORDER BY SUM(delivery_time) DESC; ```
2. 구조 맞춰보기 > ✏️ > > 1. where age between 20 and 40 > > 1. select age, count(name) count_of_name > > 1. order by age > > 1. group by age > > 1. from customers 정답 ```sql SELECT age, count(name) count_of_name FROM customers WHERE age between 20 and 40 // 나이: 20 ~ 40 GROUP BY age ORDER BY age (ASC) // 오름차순 정렬, 기본 값이기 때문에 생략 가능 ```
